text:
Acceptance bullet 4 is stale and now reads backwards. It asks to "Make Scala 3.7.4 the actual CI/publication baseline everywhere and remove stale 3.3.8/3.8.4 lanes." That was written in phase 6, before P8.B4 established the opposite on 2026-07-30: ADR 0001 as amended makes Scala 3.3.8 LTS the publication baseline with 3.8.4 as a verification-only lane, and build.sbt implements it via `publish / skip` bound to the non-baseline version.

Read that bullet as: make 3.3.8 LTS the actual publication baseline everywhere, keep 3.8.4 as a verification lane, and remove documentation and CI references to a 3.7.4 baseline. The CI matrix half was already delivered by P8.B4, which regenerated ci.yml to `scala: [3.3.8, 3.8.4]`. The -Werror half was delivered by P8.B1.

The documentation half is now done as well (2026-08-03): docs/compatibility.md, README.md, PRD.html's decision table, docs/examples/public-api.md, examples/README.md, and tools/acceptance/README.md now state the 3.3.8 baseline. docs/acceptance/v1-evidence.md carries a dated amendment rather than restated numbers, and the dated plan and p5-site-scale records were deliberately left unedited because they are historical evidence.

What remains under this bead: LICENSE, publishing metadata (licenses/developers/homepage/scmInfo), release automation, and publishLocal in the release gate. Cutting an actual baseline and proving the mima gate bites stays in P7.6.
